Brightwood Timber - Price list 2026 (effective 1 February 2026) (2026-01-28)
Item | 2025 price (EUR/m2) | 2026 price (EUR/m2) | Change
Oak veneer panel 18 mm | 42.50 | 45.90 | +8%
Birch veneer panel 18 mm | 31.25 | 33.75 | +8%
Oak veneer panel 25 mm | 55.00 | 59.40 | +8%
Applies to all deliveries from 1 February 2026.

From: Brightwood Timber Ltd
To: Niamh Brennan
Subject: Brightwood Timber - 2026 price list (effective 1 February)
Date: 2026-01-28 10:12

Dear Niamh,

Please find attached our updated price list. Because of higher kiln-drying and transport costs, prices for oak and birch veneer panels will increase by 8% for all deliveries from 1 February 2026.

Current orders delivered before 1 February keep the 2025 prices.

Kind regards,
Gareth Moss
Account Manager, Brightwood Timber Ltd

From: Niamh Brennan
To: Claire Donnelly
Subject: FW: Brightwood Timber - 2026 price list (effective 1 February)
Date: 2026-01-29 09:03

Claire,

FYI, Brightwood is putting prices up 8% from 1 February. At our usual volume (about EUR 150k a month with them) that is roughly EUR 12k a month more on timber.

I'm asking them for a volume rebate. No answer yet, I'll keep you posted.

Niamh
#finance-close - Claire Donnelly (2026-02-02 08:45): Starting the January close today. Order as usual: ERP export, workbook, mapping check, variances, commentary, pack.

# Monthly commentary - January 2026

Fictional company (Pipeline Furniture Ltd). Validated by the CFO.

EBITDA EUR 317,000 vs budget EUR 324,000 (-7,000).

No P&L line is above the EUR 5,000 threshold this month.

## Notes below threshold

- Freight out -2,900: Winter fuel surcharge from Atlantic Freight in January (below threshold, no comment required).
- Energy -2,200: Cold January, higher heating in the workshop (below threshold).

From: Tom Avery
To: Claire Donnelly
Subject: January pack - feedback
Date: 2026-02-05 17:40

Claire,

Thanks for the January pack, clear and on time.

For February onwards, keep the threshold at EUR 5,000 per line: comment every line above it, nothing below. The board wants the cause and whether it will repeat next month.

Tom

From: Mark Fallon
To: Claire Donnelly, Ellen Walsh
Subject: ERP - GL detail export timing out
Date: 2026-02-27 16:05

Hi both,

Heads-up for month end: the GL detail export is timing out for full-month ranges (known issue, ticket open with the ERP vendor).

Workaround: export 1-14 and 15-end of month separately and merge the two files. Make sure you don't paste the boundary day twice.

Mark

From: Mark Fallon
To: Claire Donnelly
Subject: Password expires in 5 days
Date: 2026-03-03 07:30

Your Pipeline password expires in 5 days. Change it from the self-service portal.

IT

# Monthly commentary - February 2026

Fictional company (Pipeline Furniture Ltd). Validated by the CFO.

EBITDA EUR 312,800 vs budget EUR 324,000 (-11,200).

## Timber & panels: -11,600

Brightwood Timber price list +8% on veneer panels from 1 February 2026 (letter of 28 January). About EUR 12k per month at normal volume. Niamh is negotiating a volume rebate.

- Repeats next month: Yes, every month until a rebate or a new supplier
- Source: Email E01 (Brightwood, 28 Jan) and E02 (Niamh, 29 Jan); GL account 5000, invoices BW-INV-10588/10631/10690

From: Claire Donnelly
To: Tom Avery
Subject: February management pack
Date: 2026-03-04 18:22

Tom,

February pack attached. EBITDA EUR 312.8k vs budget EUR 324.0k (-11.2k).

Only one line above the EUR 5k threshold: Timber & panels -11.6k. Brightwood's +8% price list applies from 1 February (letter of 28 January). It will repeat every month until Niamh gets the rebate or we change supplier.

Claire
#finance-close - Claire Donnelly (2026-03-04 18:30): February close done, pack sent to Tom. Only material line: timber (Brightwood +8%).

Weekly production meeting (2026-03-05 09:00)
Pieter de Vries: Morning everyone. First topic, the Harbour City order.
Raj Mehta: Harbour City Council confirmed order HCC-0457 yesterday. School furniture, twenty-eight thousand euros, and they need it before the schools reopen at the end of March.
Pieter de Vries: That's a rush on top of the normal plan. With the current team we can't do it in three weeks.
Pieter de Vries: I'll bring in three temporary operatives from StaffBridge for three weeks, from Monday the ninth. That's about fourteen thousand euros.
Niamh Brennan: Panels are fine, I can get the extra boards from Oakfield.
Sofia Lindqvist: Delivery to the schools is standard road freight, no problem.
Pieter de Vries: Decision: three StaffBridge operatives from 9 to 27 March for the Harbour City rush order.
Pieter de Vries: Action (Pieter): book the three operatives with StaffBridge today.
Raj Mehta: Action (Raj): confirm the delivery date to Harbour City.

From: StaffBridge Recruitment
To: Pieter de Vries
Subject: Booking confirmation - 3 operatives from 9 March
Date: 2026-03-06 14:30

Hi Pieter,

As discussed on the phone, we confirm 3 temporary operatives for your workshop from Monday 9 March to Friday 27 March (3 weeks), at the agreed daily rate. Total estimate EUR 14,000, invoiced at the end of the assignment.

Lisa Grant
StaffBridge Recruitment

From: Belvedere Hotel Group
To: Raj Mehta
Subject: Order BHG-2291 - change of delivery date
Date: 2026-03-09 11:47

Hello Raj,

Our refurbishment works at the Cork property are running late. Please postpone the delivery of order BHG-2291 (lobby and meeting room furniture, EUR 45,000) to 14 April 2026.

Invoice on delivery as agreed.

Best regards,
Anna Ross
Procurement, Belvedere Hotel Group
#sales-ops - Raj Mehta (2026-03-10 09:12): Heads-up: Belvedere pushed BHG-2291 (EUR 45k) from March to 14 April, their refurbishment is late. Nothing we can do, the order stays firm.
#production - Pieter de Vries (2026-03-11 16:02): Harbour City rush order is on track for delivery on 27 March. Busy weeks ahead in the workshop.

From: Pieter de Vries
To: Claire Donnelly, Ellen Walsh, Raj Mehta, Niamh Brennan, Sofia Lindqvist
Subject: Friday lunch - workshop 10 years
Date: 2026-03-12 12:00

Pizza in the workshop canteen on Friday at 12:30 to celebrate 10 years in the Cork building. All welcome!

Pieter
#production - Pieter de Vries (2026-03-13 12:40): Thanks all for coming to the lunch!

From: Tom Avery
To: Claire Donnelly, Ellen Walsh, Owen Kelly
Subject: Welcome Owen
Date: 2026-03-17 09:00

Please welcome Owen Kelly, who joins finance as junior analyst. Claire, please include him in the March close.

Tom

From: Brightwood Timber Ltd
To: Niamh Brennan
Subject: Price review - further adjustment from 1 May
Date: 2026-03-18 09:15

Dear Niamh,

Following our call, we are unable to offer a volume rebate this year. Please also note a further 3% increase on veneer panels for deliveries from 1 May 2026.

Kind regards,
Gareth Moss

Purchasing review (2026-03-18 14:00)
Niamh Brennan: Brightwood answered this morning. No volume rebate, and a further three percent from the first of May.
Tom Avery: So the eight percent is permanent. Claire, what does that cost us?
Claire Donnelly: About twelve thousand a month on timber since February. With three percent more from May, around sixteen to seventeen thousand a month.
Tom Avery: Decision: we look for a second supplier for veneer panels before May.
Tom Avery: Action (Niamh): get quotes from Oakfield and Nordboard by the end of April.
Tom Avery: Action (Claire): include the May increase in the Q2 forecast.
#dm-claire-niamh - Niamh Brennan (2026-03-19 10:31): Bad news on Brightwood: no rebate, and another +3% from 1 May. I'm getting quotes from Oakfield and Nordboard.

Subject: March pack by Thursday
Date: 2026-04-07 08:40

Claire,

Can I have the March pack by Thursday? EBITDA looks well below budget and the board will want the reasons line by line.

Tom

From: Claire Donnelly
To: Ellen Walsh
Subject: Leave 20 April - 8 May: April close
Date: 2026-04-10 16:10

Ellen,

As agreed, you'll run the April close while I'm on leave (20 April to 8 May). I'll write up the handoff notes on Tuesday. Owen will shadow you.

Claire

April close handoff (2026-04-14 11:00)
Claire Donnelly: Ellen, you'll run the April close, Owen shadows you. Threshold stays at five thousand per line.
Claire Donnelly: Three things carry over from March. First, the Belvedere order of forty-five thousand should be invoiced on the fourteenth of April.
Claire Donnelly: Second, the KPC kickoff of eight thousand was invoiced in March but budgeted in April, so April fees will look favourable. That's timing, not a saving.
Claire Donnelly: Third, I never found why Atlantic Freight charged express surcharges in March. Six thousand two hundred.
Ellen Walsh: Who would know?
Claire Donnelly: Sofia in logistics. I haven't asked her yet.
Claire Donnelly: Decision: Ellen leads the April close, Claire is on leave from 20 April to 8 May.
Claire Donnelly: Action (Ellen): ask Sofia which shipments used service code EXP in March.
Claire Donnelly: Action (Owen): note every question you have during the April close.
#finance-close - Claire Donnelly (2026-04-14 15:00): April close handoff notes are in the close folder (handoff_2026-04.md). Ellen leads, Owen shadows. Ping me only if something is blocking.
